name: Shellfish
overview: Scripture clearly instructs God’s people regarding the consumption of shellfish, emphasizing that creatures in the waters without fins and scales are to be regarded as an abomination. In Leviticus 11, the Lord commands through Moses and Aaron that all living things in the seas and rivers lacking these characteristics are not to be eaten. This directive highlights God’s design and holiness, calling His people to obedience in their dietary practices as a reflection of their covenant relationship with Him.
